document.executive_summary: This memo independently rechecks A's round-5 analysis for the depot charger decision. Recomputed from the trusted table, all four packages pass both gates (quality at least 80, defects at most 5), and the energy ladder is P2 15, P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 kWh on the shared acceptance basis. Every gap and ratio in A's report is arithmetically correct, and this round's margin/ratio wording is properly separated, closing the round-4 slip. The client-correct choice is P2: lowest energy at 15 kWh, 9 kWh below runner-up P3, fewest defects (1/5) and quality 95. Fallback: P3 at 24 kWh. My ballot: P2.
document.figure_caption: Independent recheck of the WO-05 energy ladder: recomputed bars P2 15, P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 kWh with verified gap callouts, ratio labels and defect-headroom chips; values match A's figures exactly.

recommendation.rationale: All four packages qualify. P2's 15 kWh is the lowest measured energy on the shared acceptance basis, 9 kWh below runner-up P3, with the fewest defects (1/5, headroom 4) and quality 95 above the 80 gate. Independently verified; P4 at 64 kWh with zero headroom cannot compete. Fallback: P3 at 24 kWh.

sections.body: The trusted table reads P1 quality 100, defects 3, energy 44 kWh; P2 95, 1, 15; P3 91, 3, 24; P4 88, 5, 64. Both gates use raw counts: quality at least 80 and defects at most 5. All four qualify, so none is rejected. Defect headroom to the 5/5 ceiling is 4 for P2, 2 for P1, 2 for P3 and 0 for P4, which sits exactly at the ceiling — one further defect would disqualify it. Quality is a gate, not a ranking weight: P1's 100 buys no advantage over P2's 95 once both clear 80.
sections.heading: Eligibility gates rechecked

sections.body: Recomputed ladder: P2 15 < P3 24 < P1 44 < P4 64 kWh. Margins over the P2 minimum: P3 +9, P1 +29, P4 +49 kWh. Consecutive gaps: 24−15 = 9, 44−24 = 20, 64−44 = 20 kWh. Ratios to P2: P3 1.60x, P1 2.93x, P4 4.27x. Every reading shares the same work-order output, load and acceptance test, so the comparison is direct with no cross-basis correction. All energies are distinct, so the candidate-ID tie-break never engages. Every ladder figure in A's report is confirmed correct.
sections.heading: Energy ladder, gaps and ratios rechecked

sections.body: A's gates, ranking, headroom and open-question list all match the trusted table. This round A states margins and ratios separately and explicitly corrects the round-4 slip that called the 9 kWh margin '2.33x'; the wording defect is closed. The facts-versus-questions split is sound: measurement uncertainty on the 15 kWh reading is unsupplied; cost, delivery, maintenance and field reliability are unverified and excluded; persistence of this acceptance basis into later work orders is unconfirmed; P4's zero-headroom fragility is flagged. No unverifiable claim entered the ranking.
sections.heading: Cross-check of A's report

sections.body: Three questions remain open and none blocks selection. First, no uncertainty bound is supplied for the 15 kWh reading; the 9 kWh margin to P3 absorbs error only if combined uncertainty stays below that gap — the client should state measurement tolerance before any near-tie decision. Second, cost, delivery, maintenance and reliability stay excluded pending client instruction. Third, the acceptance basis must be re-verified per work order; extrapolation across a changed basis is invalid. Handover: re-run both gates from the trusted table before ranking, keep margin and ratio wording separate, and flag zero-headroom candidates as fragile fallbacks.
sections.heading: Residual questions and handover

body.figure_brief: Verification memo illustration for WO-05: an independently recomputed energy-ladder bar chart supporting the B verifier's cross-check of A's report. Four bars ordered ascending on the shared kWh acceptance basis: P2 15 (green baseline), P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 (amber, zero defect headroom). Red dashed double-arrow callouts mark consecutive gaps +9, +20 and +20 kWh; white ratio labels inside taller bars read 1.60x, 2.93x and 4.27x vs P2. Below the axis, each bar carries ID, quality, raw defects and headroom chips (4/2/2/0), with P4 explicitly at the 5/5 ceiling. Check marks signal values recomputed from the trusted table; a footnote states all figures match A's report exactly.
